tasks.prompt: I have two job offers. A pays 95k with a 20 percent bonus target and a 4 percent 401k match. B pays 112k flat, no bonus, no match. Which has higher expected total compensation?
A test is 99 percent accurate for a condition that affects 1 in 1000 people. I tested positive. Is it more likely than not that I have it?
tasks.rationale: base rate dominates; posterior is roughly 9 percent

tasks.prompt: My lease says rent is due on the 1st with a 5 day grace period, and late fees are 5 percent of monthly rent. Rent is 1800. I pay on the 7th. What do I owe?
Loan A: 20000 at 6 percent simple interest over 3 years. Loan B: 20000 at 5.5 percent compounded annually over 3 years. Which costs less in total interest?
A recipe for 4 needs 300g flour and 2 eggs. I am cooking for 7. Rounding eggs up to whole eggs, what do I need?
A stock went from 80 to 60, then rose 25 percent. Am I above or below where I started?
My project has tasks A (3 days), B (2 days, needs A), C (4 days, independent), D (1 day, needs B and C). What is the minimum completion time?
tasks.rationale: critical path A then B then D is 6; C then D is 5

tasks.prompt: Plan X: 30 per month, no commitment. Plan Y: 20 per month on a 12 month contract with a 60 cancellation fee. I expect to need it for 7 months. Which is cheaper?
A dataset has 1200 rows, 15 percent missing on column A and 10 percent on column B, with no overlap in which rows are missing. If I drop any row with a missing value, how many remain?
I earn 4800 a month after tax. Rent is 1650, fixed bills 420, and I want to save 20 percent of gross take-home. How much is left for everything else?
